name: Kasugai Yui
source:
She is Mayu's junior in club activities and always follows Mayu around. Contrary to expectations, she is not after Mayu, rather there is a boy she is after.

She always gets nervous and confused when she is in front of the main character, will she ever get a chance to talk to that boy? She is like a little sister to the main character, and this worries her.

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/kimikoi/chara.htm]official site[/url]]
